checks.detail: Activity Center and explicit device-delivery sources are present
historical W434 truth is preserved and explicit AI V2 supersession is declared
Settings exposes Activity Center, explicit Enable and explicit push self-test controls
activity rows still require real redacted source events
browser permission is reachable only through the explicit device-delivery function
push endpoint custody is encrypted before D1 persistence
server delivery implements encrypted Web Push and VAPID source paths
subscription mutation and self-test are same-origin and account-scoped
service worker accepts only bounded text/internal routes and ignores remote notification icons
mission watchdog remains an explicit local activity source, not a promotional sender
Activity Center preferences/read state remain update-protected
source-ready device delivery is distinguished from not-yet-run live delivery proof

limitations: Live browser permission, real push-service acceptance, closed-tab delivery, unsubscribe and multi-device behavior still require deployment/runtime proof.
Marketing/reward push remains prohibited; service-device alerts require explicit opt-in.
